subject: The eighteen Channel EQ band parameters that reached State A, driven A -> B -> A with a fourth write of the same value
question: A one-way State A says a write landed once. Does the same parameter come BACK, and does rewriting the value it already holds still verify?

reverify.command: Manual because it needs a Channel EQ on a uniquely named track. For each of the six non-Cut bands crossed with Frequency, Gain and Q, call `logic_plugins.set_eq_band_verified` with unit `raw_ax_value` four times: A, then B, then A, then A again. A/B are 500/560 for Frequency, 200/240 for Gain, 20/26 for a shelf Q and 50/63 for a peak Q.
reverify.expected: All four writes return State A with verified true and observed_normalized equal to the request. The fourth reports walk_steps 0 — the value is already there and the readback still confirms it.

method: Driven against the release binary talking to a live Logic, on the Channel EQ at insert 1 of the track named `Absolute Zero` in `lpm-locale-campaign.logicx`, resolved by `target_ref` from `logic://tracks` rather than by index. Requests used `raw_ax_value`, so the number written and the number read back are the same quantity and no engineering conversion sits between them. The pairs were chosen inside each parameter's declared raw range: far enough apart that arriving is distinguishable from not moving, close enough that the increment walk finishes. Four writes per parameter: settle at A, A->B, B->A, then A again. The third and fourth are the point — the third asks whether the control comes back, the fourth whether a write of the value already held still verifies rather than being reported as a no-op success.

observations.what: parameters that verified a rewrite of the value already held
observations.note: the fourth write reported walk_steps 0 and still returned state A with verified true

observations.what: Q on Low Shelf and High Shelf
bands not driven in this sweep
observations.why: they refused one-way on 2026-09-13 and were not re-driven here

conclusion: All 18 Channel EQ parameters that reach State A move in BOTH directions and stay put when rewritten. That is what this catalog means by a verified parameter and what ADR-009 asks for under 'A/B write proof, idempotency': the 18 were held at `observed` on 2026-09-13 precisely because only one direction had been measured, and they are `verified` now because the other direction was.
limits: One Channel EQ instance, on one track, in one project, on a Korean Logic 12.3. Nothing here speaks for a second instance, another host locale, or Logic on another machine.

One pair of values per parameter kind, chosen mid-range. The extremes of each declared raw range were NOT driven, so nothing here says the parameter reaches its own min or max — which ADR-009's evidence list asks for separately and this sweep does not supply.
The two Cut bands were not re-driven. They refused one-way on 2026-09-13 and are assumed to refuse reciprocally; that assumption was not tested, and WHY they refuse is still unestablished.
Idempotency was measured as one immediate rewrite. Nothing here says the value survives a window close, a project reload, or any other Logic-side event.

`raw_ax_value` only. The engineering-unit path (Hz, dB, Q) compares against Logic's rendered AXValueDescription and is a different comparison; it was exercised on 2026-09-13 one-way and not in this sweep.
